scope: React renderHook with the actual source modules, actual fake-indexeddb transactions, and a controlled HTTP transport using strictly constructed synthetic PracticeSession payloads; no native browser, live HTTP service, or full acceptance claim.

results.name: cross_session_candidate_rebound
results.steps: Open session A; edit without waiting for automatic server save; rerender the same hook instance with session B of the same exact practice set.
results.observation: A_ONLY_UNSENT is journaled under B, then an automatic PUT writes it to B.

results.name: switch_during_response_put
results.steps: Start a delayed PUT for A; rerender with session B; complete the old PUT acknowledgement.
results.observation: Only GET A occurs; B is never read, snapshot remains A, state remains saving.

results.name: stale_response_cas_conflict
results.observation: 412 preserves local candidate in visible conflict and actual IndexedDB.

results.name: submitted_server_with_unsent_local_candidate
results.observation: Explicit keep-local after remote submitted retains the candidate in IndexedDB and does not issue PUT.

cleanup: All React hooks unmounted and the IndexedDB store closed; no network servers were started. Temporary evidence remains for replay.
production_reachability: Initial two failures used same-hook rerender A-to-B. Production Shell keys PracticeView by active.id, whose tab identity includes the practice session ID; that normal switch unmounts the old hook. Do not interpret the experiment as a confirmed production cross-session write.
publication_note: Derived public receipt. Raw receipts remain unmodified; manifest.json binds raw and published bytes. Historical temporary harness imports use explicit path placeholders; use the permanent repository test for replay.
scope_correction: The initial active sessions were strict public DTO fixtures, but its submitted control only changed status/revision and retained results=null, which is not a valid submitted DTO. That initial control is historical diagnostic evidence only. The later fixed run and permanent test use all five strict needs_review result records with null scores and null solution text.
source_drift_warning: The source changed during the initial run. These failures cannot be assigned to one immutable source SHA or treated as failures of the current hook.
